rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a company or business.

example.english: This enterprise mainly helps people with online promotion.
example.traditional: 呢間公司主要幫人做網上宣傳。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zyu2 jiu3 bong1 jan4 zou6 mong5 soeng6 syun1 cyun4

rows.note: Use this for a substantial venture or undertaking, especially one viewed as an ongoing enterprise rather than a single project.

example.english: They spent ten years and finally built their own enterprise.
example.traditional: 佢哋用咗十年時間，終於建立起自己嘅事業。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 zo2 sap6 nin4 si4 gaan1 zung1 jyu1 gin3 laap6 hei2 zi6 gei2 ge3 si6 jip6

rows.note: Use this for a person's energetic drive and willingness to take on new challenges.

example.english: They have the enterprise to take on new challenges.
example.traditional: 佢做嘢好有幹勁，成日主動接啲新挑戰。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 jau5 gon3 ging3 seng4 jat6 zyu2 dung6 zip3 di1 san1 tiu1 zin3
